title: Universal Pickleball Anthem - G4 Clean
style: soul blues gospel phonk, cinematic orchestral, 142 BPM, heavy 808, cowbell, chopped vocal chops, Spanish chants, Mandarin chants, stadium energy, pure pickleball hype, every player smashing
lyrics:
[Intro]
The court is calling... every player hears it...
Wind in your favor... timeless...

[Verse]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame...
When every shot says none is right...
We still smash... smash... smash!

[Pre-Drop]
¡Vamos! ¡SMASH!

[Drop]
SMASH IT! SMASH IT!
Go for it, the time is right now!
Sooooo... SMASH IT!

[Mandarin]
加油! 力量! 永远!

[Final]
We in overdrive... ¡Vamos!
Pickleball forever... 永远!
SMASH IT! 加油! 力量!

[Outro]
Pickleball... forever...
